source: saas-dev:warm-cache skill — live MCP queries (shadcn, MagicUI, 21st.dev)

components.name: Button
components.description: Accessible button primitive with cva variants (default, destructive, outline, secondary, ghost, link) and sizes (sm, default, lg, icon). Uses Radix Slot for asChild composition. Base: inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-md text-sm font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:ring-2.

components.name: Input
components.description: Text input with rounded-lg border, bg-background, subtle shadow-sm shadow-black/5, focus-visible:ring-[3px] ring-ring/20. Height h-9, px-3 py-2. Supports search/file type variants via cn().

components.name: Label
components.description: Radix LabelPrimitive wrapper. text-sm font-medium leading-none, peer-disabled:opacity-70. Always pair with form inputs via htmlFor.

components.name: Card
components.description: Composable surface: Card (rounded-lg border bg-card shadow-sm), CardHeader (flex flex-col space-y-1.5 p-6), CardTitle (text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight), CardDescription (text-sm text-muted-foreground), CardContent (p-6 pt-0), CardFooter (flex items-center p-6 pt-0).

components.name: Separator
components.description: Radix SeparatorPrimitive. Horizontal: h-[1px] w-full bg-border. Use with absolute-positioned label span for 'or continue with' dividers.

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: Radix CheckboxPrimitive. peer h-4 w-4 shrink-0 rounded-sm border border-primary, data-[state=checked]:bg-primary data-[state=checked]:text-primary-foreground. Check icon from lucide-react inside Indicator.

components.name: Form
components.description: Auth form pattern from 21st.dev: Logo + heading above form. Label → Input (mt-2) → full-width primary Button (mt-4 w-full). Separator divider with centered 'or with' text. Outline Button with Google SVG icon for OAuth. Terms/privacy microcopy below. Card-based layout with CardHeader, CardContent, CardFooter composition.

components.name: Sign In button
components.description: Full-width primary action Button (w-full) inside CardContent or form. Uses bg-primary text-primary-foreground with hover:bg-primary/90. Transition-transform hover:scale-[1.03] for premium feel. Submit type for form integration.

components.name: GoogleOAuthButton
components.description: Outline variant Button, full-width, inline-flex justify-center space-x-2. Google 'G' SVG icon (viewBox 0 0 24 24, multi-color #4285F4/#34A853/#FBBC05/#EA4335 or single-path currentColor) at size-5. Text 'Sign in with Google' or 'Continue with Google'. Use Button variant='outline' with asChild wrapping an anchor tag.

components.name: Password input
components.description: Input type=password with show/hide toggle button. Relative wrapper with Input className='pe-9'. Toggle button absolute inset-y-0 end-0 with Eye/EyeOff icons from lucide-react at size=16. aria-label for accessibility. useState boolean for visibility toggle.

components.name: Link
components.description: Use Button variant='link' for CTA-style links (text-primary underline-offset-4 hover:underline). Inline text links: text-primary font-medium hover:underline. For 'Create account' and 'Forgot password?' links.

components.name: Logo / Product name
components.description: Brand logo rendered as img element or SVG inside a centered flex container above the form title. img className='h-12 w-12 object-contain rounded-[4px]'. Can use Material Symbols smart_toy robot icon for AI branding. Paired with CardTitle for product name below.

components.name: Tagline text
components.description: CardDescription component below CardTitle. text-sm text-muted-foreground. Short descriptive text like 'Enter your credentials to access your account.' Centered in CardHeader.

components.name: pulsating-button
components.description: An animated pulsating button useful for capturing attention of users. Subtle pulse animation on the primary CTA. Use sparingly — only for the main Sign In action, not secondary buttons.

components.name: magic-card
components.description: Spotlight effect card that follows mouse cursor and highlights borders on hover. Useful for featured surfaces but NOT for auth forms where stability matters. Use only for marketing-adjacent sections.

components.name: neon-gradient-card
components.description: A beautiful neon card effect with gradient border glow. Premium feel for hero cards. Compatible with glassmorphism aesthetic.

components.name: border-beam
components.description: An animated beam of light which travels along the border of its container. Subtle premium accent for CTA cards. Compatible with glassmorphism — apply to the outer Card wrapper.

components.name: animated-gradient-text
components.description: An animated gradient background which transitions between colors for text. Use for headline/brand wordmarks only. Lock gradient colors to the project's design system tokens.
